name: Ring Muscle-Up
steps: Hang beneath high gymnastic rings in a false grip with your wrists wrapped over the rings, arms straight, and core tight.
Pull explosively upward while drawing the rings tight to your chest and lower ribs.
Lean your shoulders rapidly forward over the rings as your elbows turn vertically behind you into the bottom of a dip.
Press forcefully upward until your arms lock straight overhead on the rings, then reverse smoothly back down to the hang.
tips: Keep the rings close together against your chest during the transition instead of letting them drift wide.
Master strict false-grip pull-ups and deep ring dips before attempting the full transition.
